source: OCHA South Sudan 3W operational presence (HDX), compiled by the team (Nov 2026)
aggregation: distinct organisations reporting activity in this sector in the county that month
label: Protection and GBV partners present
notes: Number of aid organisations reporting protection work in the county that month; protection here includes gender-based violence, child protection and mine action, which the source does not separate. A stand-in for crisis and survivor services, not a count of service points. No data for December 2020. The way the 3W is reported changes from year to year (2023-2024 have more counties at zero), so month-to-month changes within a year are more reliable than comparisons between years.
